item.title: Church’s Texas Chicken Coming to North Buffalo
item.description: Muhammad Shoaib is opening the region’s second Church’s Texas Chicken restaurant in at 2165 Delaware Avenue that previously was home to Jet’s Pizza. Last year, Shoaib opened a Church’s on the first floor of the Hyatt Place Hotel in downtown Niagara Falls. Shoaib purchased the 1,475 sq.ft. building on 0.27-acre corner lot with off-street parking for 13 cars in March 2025 for $390,000. item.description: As the City scopes out ways to deal with another budget deficit, one solution by Mayor Sean Ryan is to override the 2% state property tax cap. item.title: Community Meeting on Entrances to Delaware Park Ring Road
item.description: Join Buffalo Olmsted Parks Conservancy (BOPC) at the upcoming Community Meeting on the Entrances to Delaware Park Ring Road! Thursday, March 26, 2026 | 5:30 pm – 7 pm | 84 Parkside Ave, Buffalo, NY 14214 The City of Buffalo and BOPC have proposed permanent designs for the entrances to Delaware Park Meadow, namely Agassiz Circle entrance, Colvin/Amherst entrance, and the Nottingham Terrace entrance. Join BOPC on March 26 to learn more and share your input. RSVP encouraged: bfloparks.org/oca/rsvp
